about.title: About
about.pitch: I design dependable data/AI platforms: real-time ingestion, ML/DL, APIs, dashboards, automation, with security-first reflexes.
contribution: Product mindset: fast scoping, POC → MVP, demos that reassure.
Pragmatic tech lead: prioritization, managed debt, lightweight docs.

Quality: strict validation, API tests, load guardrails.

projects.title: Hackathon #1 — Twitter-like platform + FER AI
projects.tagline: Real-time social app + facial expression recognition delivered in 4 days
projects.summary: Feed, real-time notifications, FER via webcam, secure Node API.
projects.problem: Ship a rich social platform with a live AI service in a single weekend without dropping basic security.
projects.solution: Modular build: React front, Node/Express API + MongoDB, Flask AI service (CNN FER), Socket.io for realtime. Flow: webcam → Flask API → emotion result → badge in UI.
projects.architecture: React front → Node API (JWT auth, validation) → MongoDB Atlas → Socket.io → Flask FER service.
projects.diagram: graph LR; UI[React front + feed]-->API[Node/Express API]; API-->Auth[(JWT + MongoDB)]; API-->Socket[Socket.io]; API-->IA[Flask FER API]; IA-->API; API-->UI;
highlights: Tweets 280 chars, media, hashtags/@mentions, likes/RT/comments, bookmarks.
FER AI: 7 emotions + playful “Mona Lisa” mode for the demo.
results: Delivered in 4 days with a stable demo.
learnings: Socket.io rooms and Mongo query budgeting.
Quick-hardening: payload validation and strict CORS.
projects.impact: Credible demo of a social platform + AI shipped at hackathon speed.

projects.title: Real-time music events pipeline + dashboard
projects.tagline: Kafka ingestion → Spark Structured Streaming → HDFS → Flask API → React dashboard
projects.summary: End-to-end streaming + storage + audio dashboard with monitoring.
projects.problem: Ingest and process music events in real time with durable storage and an API layer.
projects.solution: Python producer → Kafka → Spark Structured Streaming (clean/enrich) → HDFS (bronze Parquet) → gold batch → Flask API → React dashboard with audio player.
projects.architecture: Docker Compose orchestration, dedicated topics, Spark checkpoints, bronze/parquet layers, REST exposure on Flask + reactive UI.
projects.diagram: graph TD; Producer[Python Producer]-->Kafka[Kafka topics]; Kafka-->Spark[Spark Structured Streaming]; Spark-->HDFS[(HDFS Bronze Parquet)]; HDFS-->Batch[Gold/Curated batch]; Batch-->API[Flask API]; API-->Dashboard[React dashboard + player]; Dashboard-->Users
highlights: Dashboard with filters, audio timeline, metric cards.
results: End-to-end data/AI demo ready for ML add-ons.
security: Secret isolation (env) and Kafka/HDFS ACL principles.
projects.impact: Solid base to plug recommendation or anomaly detection models.
